pkgmetadata.longdescription: Zarr is a Python package for storing N-dimensional arrays in a chunked, compressed format. It supports multiple storage backends (local filesystem, cloud object stores, zip files, and in-memory), codec pipelines, and is compatible with the Zarr v2 and v3 specifications.

use.flag: Install the zarr command-line interface (requires typer)
Enable remote storage support via fsspec and obstore
